methodHandling.otherMethods: Method never checked; any method behaves like GET (body ignored).

auth.notes: Auth before the jobId check: no token -> 401 'Missing bearer token'; bad token -> 401 'Invalid or expired session'.

query.name: jobId
query.invalidBehaviour: missing or empty -> 400 'jobId is required'. Any non-empty string is used verbatim as part of the blob key storyline/{jobId}.json; an unknown id returns {status:'pending'}.

responses.when: no job blob exists yet (or unknown jobId)
job blob exists, status pending (written by /api/storyline)
responses.cite: storyline-status.ts:13; storyline.ts:17. result/error are undefined and dropped by JSON.stringify.

result.inputs: WizardInputs exactly as POSTed to /api/storyline (unknown fields included)
result.slides: array of Storyline slides (number,title,type,section?,framework,description,bullets,chartData?,archetypeId?) after insertDividers, each plus `prompt` (server-assembled image prompt)

example.error: Claude returned an incomplete storyline — please try again or reduce the number of slides

errors.when: job exists and belongs to another user

quirks: Unknown/never-written jobId returns 200 {status:'pending'} rather than 404, and before the ownership check — any user polling any non-existent id sees pending forever.

Response always built as {status, result, error}; undefined members are omitted from the JSON, so a pending job is exactly {"status":"pending"}, a done job has no `error` key, an error job has no `result` key.

Error strings in status:'error' are either the fixed Zod message 'Claude returned an incomplete storyline — please try again or reduce the number of slides', the raw Error.message of whatever failed (Anthropic SDK error text, 'Missing required env var: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY', Supabase errors), or 'Storyline generation failed' for non-Error throws (storyline-background.ts:34-44). ZodError detection is by constructor name (storyline-background.ts:34).
No TTL: job blobs are never deleted.

tests.asserts: done job for owner -> 200 with result.presentationTitle; missing blob -> pending; other user's job -> 403; no jobId -> 400 (lines 18-47)

callers.where: src/lib/api.ts:39-44 (getStorylineStatus), polled by pollStoryline src/lib/api.ts:48-61 every 2s, max 90 polls
callers.expects: status 'done' with result -> returns result; 'error' -> throws error || 'Storyline generation failed'; anything else keeps polling

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:584-634 — shape matches.
